title: 20 Golden Rules Every Investor Should Remember

blocks.value:
1. Invest only what you understand.
2. Never invest borrowed money.
3. Diversify.
4. Think long term.
5. Stay patient.
6. Ignore market noise.
7. Don't chase tips.
8. Review your portfolio.
9. Keep learning.
10. Protect your capital.
11. Don't panic.
12. Don't get greedy.
13. Focus on quality.
14. Read annual reports.
15. Track expenses.
16. Respect risk.
17. Invest regularly.
18. Continue learning.
19. Trust your process.
20. Wealth is built over decades, not days.
